text:
Alex W: Heads up — product wants a single "unit cost per 1k tokens" tile in the console. We need clear runtime/infra inputs: batching, cache hit rate, model token price, and any routing policy deltas. @Maria P can you compile the telemetry event names we should use?
Maria P: Yep. I can map events but need conventions. Do we want separate metrics for prefix cache vs KV cache? And do we want per-model cost vs per-route cost? :thinking_face:
Ben I: For infra: prefer separate metrics. KV cache hit rate (kv_hit, kv_request), prefix cache (pref_cache_hit). Batching needs a distribution: batch_size histogram + avg_latency_by_batch. Routing policy delta is trickier — we can tag requests with route_policy and model_variant.
Sophie L: Also add quota/limit events — when requests are throttled or downgraded to a cheaper model. Those affect effective unit cost. Use tags: quota_action={allowed,throttled,fallback}.
TJ: From platform side, we should emit a consolidated telemetry event for billing_calc that includes: model_id, route_policy, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, kv_hit_bool, batch_size, cost_per_token_at_serving_time. That lets us compute per-1k cost in analytics.
Kai (product): UX asks for a breakdown in the tile: base model cost, batch/caching savings, routing downgrade cost/savings. Also a small-time-range selector (1h/24h/7d) and ability to filter by team or route.
Maria P: Draft event names and a sample BigQuery join keys: 
```
-- events: request_log
request_ts, request_id, user_id, model_id, route_policy, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, batch_size, kv_hit, pref_cache_hit, quota_action
-- model_prices table keyed by model_id+timestamp: cost_per_token_nano
```
Maria P: I'll send a mapping PR for schema. Quick question: how do you want to handle model price time variance? Use cost snapshot per hour?
Ben I: Cost snapshots hourly is fine. Runtime will push a model_price_update event when pricing changes. We'll join by nearest_hour <= request_ts.
Sophie L: For rollouts UX: when a canary model is used we should add a boolean canary=true in events so the dashboard can show unit economics per rollout. Also add rollout_tag for A/B groups.
Alex W: Timeline: product wants an initial tile by next Tuesday for the exec demo. Can we get the telemetry PR by Friday so infra can wire ingestion?
TJ: I'll scope the ingestion pipeline — we can add the billing_calc raw event to the metrics topic. Need owners: Maria to own schema, Ben to own runtime tags, TJ to own ingestion, Sophie to own alerting for cost regressions.
Kai (product): +1 on owners. Also request a UI mock in Figma by Monday so we can iterate.
Maria P: On it. PR from me tomorrow late afternoon. I'll include sample queries for cache-savings: 
```
-- compute cache savings per 1k tokens
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN kv_hit THEN 0 ELSE tokens_out END) AS billed_tokens,
  1000 * SUM(cost_per_token * (CASE WHEN kv_hit THEN 0 ELSE tokens_out END)) / 1000 AS cost_per_1k
FROM request_log
JOIN model_prices USING(model_id, billing_hour)
WHERE request_ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();
```
Ben I: That SQL looks good as a starting point. We'll add batch_size weighting later.
deploy-bot: deploy/metrics-ingest-service #345 succeeded :white_check_mark:
Alex W: Awesome. If anyone sees blockers, flag in this thread. Otherwise we sync Tues 10am to review the first dashboard snapshot. :thumbsup:
